- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release

Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] Account Ownership and Saved Pet Verification Copy: Updates sign_in headline and body copy to clearly assure returning users that signing into their primary account will immediately retrieve their saved pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account recovery copy crucial for user retention.)
1: [home, wait_info] Background Rendering System Wait Info: Adds real-time status updates and estimated wait time to the waiting screen while desktop graphics assets initialize. (why: Wait_info changes in home step previously boosted conversion by +2.9% average, helping users endure the median 201s waiting step.)
2: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet Collection Preview Screen: Adds a new pet collection showcase screen before path selection to highlight available pet companions and set expectations. (why: Choose_path screen suffers from 81.7% conversion with high mean time (514s), showing users need early context before picking a creation path.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Generation Diagnostic Flow: Adds a pet quality check flow during custom pet creation to validate uploaded photos and prevent generation glitches. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or corrupted pet appearances, causing drop-off during adoption.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Asset Initialization Wait Info: Displays step-by-step loading status tips on the waiting screen to clarify desktop engine setup progress. (why: 3 support tickets mentioned pet not showing up on desktop or app failing to open, while home wait_info tests consistently show +2.9% conversion gains.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Recovery Clarification Copy: Adds clear messaging to sign_in body explaining that signing in restores existing pets and prevents duplicate desktop profiles. (why: Sign_in copy changes have a strong track record (+3.1% average win rate across 5 winning tests) and address 8 emails about lost pets.)
6: [adoption, reorder] Pet Adoption Flow Reorder: Reorders the adoption screens by structuring pet selection directly into the customized flow sequence. (why: Adoption has low conversion (77.8%) and high mean time (1017s); refining screen arrangement streamlines onboarding progression.)
